notes: Rigorous column: 30 stages (1 the vapour_liquid condenser, 30 the reboiler), feed on stage 24, at 100 kPa without pressure drop. The MESH equations of every stage were solved together by Newton's method (Naphtali-Sandholm), started by the bubble-point start, Newton resumed without the early stop, in 27 iterations; every group of residuals is within its tolerance (state.residuals). Converged is not validated against data: the result is as good as the method and its parameters.

The vapour + liquid condenser (proposal 0026) at 326.1 K, fixed by condenser_T_K = 326.15: stage 1 is an equilibrium stage whose vapour leaves as the vapour distillate (outlet "vapour_distillate", 298.292 kmol/h) and whose liquid is split, with one composition, into the reflux and the liquid distillate (outlet "distillate", 4532.71 kmol/h). The reflux ratio is the reflux over the liquid distillate, 2 (over the whole distillate 1.87651); distillate_kmol_h is the whole distillate, liquid and vapour.
